name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Finish Coat
intent: Cut-in at junctions (qt_scaled) + field finish by method. 4 application methods: brush_roll, spray, spray_backroll, spray_backbrush.
doctrine: Porch ceiling finish coat. Cut-in at fascia/wall/column junctions (qt_scaled QT2:400, QT3:300, QT4:200). Brush/roll 120, spray 250, spray_backroll 200, spray_backbrush 180. Back-work rates include the back-brush/back-roll labor. Panel joints modifier on brush_roll only. No intercoat sanding on porch ceiling (field surface).
